principles: Do not install a package merely because it is popular.
Prefer a new tool only when it adds a distinct mathematical or execution capability.
Keep the Compute Center network-denied; external computational APIs belong in the Evidence/Usage layer.
Every promoted tool needs pinned dependencies, a bounded gateway, deterministic tests where possible, resource limits and rollback.

high_priority_unique_candidates.capability_added: Second independent SMT/theorem-proving engine with proof production, synthesis and theory coverage beyond a single Z3 implementation.
high_priority_unique_candidates.overlap: Partial overlap with Z3, but useful for solver cross-checks and proof-oriented tasks.
high_priority_unique_candidates.deployment: Python wheel available; add only through a fixed SMT cross-validation gateway.

high_priority_unique_candidates.capability_added: Fast exact integer/rational/polynomial computation and Arb real/complex ball arithmetic with rigorous error bounds.
high_priority_unique_candidates.overlap: SageMath can expose related mathematics, but python-flint is lighter and directly suitable for certified numerical kernels.
high_priority_unique_candidates.deployment: Add through a certified-numerics gateway with precision, dimension and timeout limits.

conditional_heavier_candidates.capability_added: Multidisciplinary coupled-model assembly, derivative-aware optimization and system-level analysis.
conditional_heavier_candidates.overlap: General optimization already exists; the unique value is explicit coupling of heterogeneous disciplinary components.
conditional_heavier_candidates.condition: Promote only when a real cross-domain engineering or infrastructure model requires coupled components.

conditional_heavier_candidates.capability_added: JAX-backed probabilistic programming with automatic differentiation and JIT acceleration.
conditional_heavier_candidates.overlap: PyMC and existing Bayesian tools already cover most ordinary inference tasks.
conditional_heavier_candidates.condition: Promote only after benchmarks show a material speed or differentiable-model advantage that justifies JAX dependency weight.

conditional_heavier_candidates.capability_added: Optimal-control and trajectory optimization on top of OpenMDAO.
conditional_heavier_candidates.overlap: Vehicle routing and ordinary optimization do not provide continuous-time optimal control.
conditional_heavier_candidates.condition: Requires OpenMDAO and a concrete trajectory/optimal-control production use case.

do_not_duplicate_or_misplace.reason: The Evidence Center knowledge-tools provider already exposes bounded Wolfram full-results, short-answer and LLM-result operations. The network-denied Compute Center must not call it directly.
Pinned and used by the causal module.
These are execution/data-processing engines. Add only if measured workload size exceeds the current bounded pandas/NumPy path; do not treat them as reasoning upgrades.
Formal proof/model-checking systems require separate pinned runtimes, languages and proof artifacts; do not mix them into ordinary Python task requirements.

next_acceptance_sequence: Build isolated cvc5 and python-flint canaries on GitHub Actions.
Measure install time, wheel availability, memory, deterministic output and rollback.
Implement one bounded gateway per accepted capability; arbitrary formulas or modules remain prohibited.
Run cross-check benchmarks against Z3/SageMath and promote only if the new tool adds verifiable value.
